title: [review] provisioning.py:354: Potential None dereference whe
description: session.provisioned_seed can be None if the BR session was created via create_br_session() rather than provision_node(). Identity.from_seed(None) will raise TypeError, crashing the request handler. The provisioned_seed is only set in provision_node() (line 522), but _handle_br_post() can execute when sessions are created via the lower-level API.
close_reason: Verified: guard at line 351 already protects against None dereference. Added regression test test_br_post_handles_none_provisioned_seed_gracefully to ensure the edge case stays covered.
